prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native-resolution DFU NPC eye-animation atlas
Primary request: Create one clean 2×2 pixel-art upper-face atlas for the same woman in the inspected original reference. Show restrained anger, clear but not exaggerated.
Input images: Image 1 only: exact NPC073 original upper-half reference grid, used for identity, framing, face, pixel scale, and colors.
Subject: Preserve the same NPC woman, narrow eye shape, compact amber-olive irises, tiny subdued source-like glints, blue wand at left, hair, skin, nose bridge, and background.
Composition: Four equal complete 64×35 upper-half cells in a 2×2 atlas, row-major: OPEN / HALF CLOSED / FULLY CLOSED / repeat OPEN. Keep every crop complete and aligned. No gutters, labels, borders, or added margins.
Style/medium: Crisp low-resolution pixel art with stepped native clusters and the source's muted brown shadows and restrained highlights.
Expression: One restrained angry expression in every cell. Draw exactly one continuous, gently stepped, tapered brown eyebrow over each eye. Lower each inner end slightly toward the bridge; keep outer tails smooth and connected. Add mild bridge tension. Keep brow shape and position stable across all four cells. Avoid sharp V angles, square or notched brows, broken segments, doubled or parallel dark shadows.
Eyes/blink: Keep both eyeballs and pupils stationary, same size, alignment, and hue in every cell. HALF must visibly close through the upper lids covering the upper iris. CLOSED must cover iris and sclera with continuous lids. Keep lower lids, cheeks, and nose bridge fixed. No horizontal pupil shift, cheek lift, white sclera stripe, or bright glint.
Constraints: Change brows and lids only. Preserve source face, hairline, wand, framing, palette, and all other features. No extra creases, marks, thick black outline, smooth/vector eyes, blur, or resampling within a cell.
